mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level relative to its 5-year average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 5-year average correlates with negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economic regime, a decline in industrial production signals an impending contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of supply-constrained periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above its 12-month average correlates with negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowing of job growth below 100k and rising unemployment rate signals a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS < 100k and UNRATE rising fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in retail sales signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS decline does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
